This notebook installs the project Spack layer. Spack works by creating
a project specific DAG of dependencies and finding the best way to build them.
Installation will usually work, but you can use this notebook to debug installation issues.

Do not run `rv sync`, `uv sync`, Quarto checks, or VS Code, yet.

```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
import submitit
from rse_workbench.helpers import show_submitit_job
from rse_workbench.build_install import install_in_container
```

```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
executor = submitit.AutoExecutor(folder=str(project_contract.submitit_dir / "%j"))
executor.update_parameters(
    timeout_min=project_contract.slurm_build_hours * 60 * 3,
    slurm_partition=project_contract.slurm_build_partition,
    mem_gb=float(project_contract.slurm_build_mem.rstrip("G")),
    cpus_per_task=project_contract.slurm_build_cpus,
    slurm_job_name=f"install-spack-{project_contract.project_name}",
    mail_user=project_contract.slurm_email,
)
```

```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
SPACK_INSTALL_COMMAND = r'''
set -euo pipefail

df -h /tmp /work
source /work/env/activate.sh

which spack
which python3
spack debug report
spack concretize --force
spack install --deprecated --fail-fast -j6 --no-checksum
spack find

echo SPACK_INSTALL_DONE
'''
```

```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
job = executor.submit(
    install_in_container,
    project_dir=project_contract.project_dir,
    SINGULARITY_IMAGE=project_contract.singularity_image,
    runtime_command=SPACK_INSTALL_COMMAND,
)
job.job_id
```

```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
result = show_submitit_job(job)
if result is not None:
    print(''.join(result['message']))
```

Stop here until the Spack layer succeeds.
